Note wording only (the mapping and recompute belong to other roles): net cash is described as cash plus short- and long-term marketable investments less debt via {{net_cash}}, and the uncomputed rating claim is dropped.

Note wording only: added a 'Valuation caveat (our view, analyst judgment)' paragraph. Refundable customer deposits recorded as noncurrent customer contract liabilities are treated as operating liabilities and not deducted as debt. The reasons given are the 10-K's contract-liability classification and the conditional return. The counterpoints are also stated: the cash sits inside reported cash, the 10-K says nearly all deposits are scheduled to be repaid between 2029 and 2031 (periodic.txt lines 1763 and 2961; year labels only), and the FCF path excludes the repayment. Treating the deposits as debt-like would lower value modestly. The paragraph is qualitative because no code key or narrative quote supplies the amount. A matching line was added under Risks.
